=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text tyes "yes"
text tno "no"
note the 20 blocks, two letters each, separated by spaces
text blocks "BO XK DQ CP NA GT RE TG QD FS JW HU VI AN OB ER FS LY PC ZM"
text w0 "A"
text w1 "BARK"
text w2 "BOOK"
text w3 "TREAT"
text w4 "COMMON"
text w5 "SQUAD"
text w6 "CONFUSE"
global used uchar 20
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
fn emitb b bool to void
if b
emit tyes
else
emit tno
end
end
note onblock: block b carries letter c
fn onblock b ulong c uchar to bool
x = mul b 3
ret or eq get blocks x c eq get blocks add x 1 c
end
note can: letters i.. of w can be spelled with the unused blocks (depth-first, a block is taken
note back when the rest fails)
fn can w view uchar * i ulong to bool
if eq i len w
ret true
end
c = get w i
for b ulong 20
if eq get used b 0
if onblock b c
put used b 1
if can w add i 1
ret true
end
put used b 0
end
end
end
ret false
end
fn show w view uchar * to void
for b ulong 20
put used b 0
end
emit w
emit sp
emitb can w 0
emit nl
end
fn main to int
show w0
show w1
show w2
show w3
show w4
show w5
show w6
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
A yes
BARK yes
BOOK no
TREAT yes
COMMON no
SQUAD yes
CONFUSE yes
</pre>
